basis: renders a bare <div> — sidebar geometry only, no semantics of its own.

responsive.basis: the sidebar+content row is flex-wrap with a min-width floor on the content pane, so it collapses on the container's own width with no media query; doc-order semantics put side="left" first when stacked (#158); and the row's own gap steps gap-3 sm:gap-4 (12 below sm, 16 at or above it) when the gap prop is on. #275 keeps the wrapped sidebar's width unpinned.

interaction.basis: a collapsible region around navigation — the collapse act is its own.

exceptions.because: sidebar.e2e.ts pins geometry only — the collapse control's keyboard contract is unproven in browser
